purpose: Choose the required answers that should show a "?" with a short Georgian explanation after they are found.
criterion: A typical adult player may not know the word, or knows it by name without knowing what it is, as with ბიტი and ბაიტი.

groups.objects: Old tools, crafts and household things

limitations: The selection is assistant editorial judgement from reading each word and its recorded meaning. It is not player data or a native-speaker review.
Only the 1,941 distinct answers in the active 500 levels were read. The 362 approved words no board uses and the 52 approvals awaiting integration are not covered.
Meanings are copied unchanged from the revision 31 allowlist. A few look imprecise (ურემი is recorded as "cartload") and must be checked when explanations are written.

ketsi, earthenware frying pan (usually from clay)

selection.decision: The owner selected the 149 recommended words. The 193 borderline words are not selected.

secondReview.decision: The owner selected 144 of the 219 second-review words.
